system.description:
This skill targets the next scene. The difficulty of the check is equal to the lowest [Identification Difficulty] amongst all enemies appearing in the scene. You learn the number of enemies appearing, as well as each enemy's Rank, and whether they have the [Boss] or [Mob] tags. 

(Fumble): The enemy notices your scouting.

A special skill that scouts the surroundings and grasps the number and rough strength of the enemy. On rare occasions, the enemy will notice you.
